# PRINTFY 3D — business and product information

> PRINTFY 3D is a 3D-printing shop based in Cairo, Egypt. It sells ready-made 3D-printed décor, gifts and accessories, and accepts custom print requests. The store serves customers across Egypt and confirms orders through WhatsApp.

Official website: https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/
Languages: English and Arabic
Currency: Egyptian pound (EGP)
Taglines used on the site: “Your Ideas. Printed.” and “Turn Ideas Into Reality.”

## Current source of truth

Product names, photos, options, prices and availability can change. Check the live product page or shop before quoting any specific product information. The sitemap lists the current public category, product, English and Arabic pages:
https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/sitemap.xml

The catalog is available at https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/shop/. Product detail pages are linked from the catalog. Categories include gifts, home décor, incense holders, name stands, keychains, wall art, toys and figurines. Do not invent missing product data or claim a product is in stock without checking its current listing.

## Business and contact

- Based in Cairo, Egypt; prints made to order in Cairo.
- Delivery is available across Egypt; delivery is charged separately.

- Workshop visiting hours are not published; customers should contact the business before visiting.

## Shopping and custom printing

### Catalog products
Catalog items are printed after the customer orders. The shop displays current product details and EGP prices. Printing for standard catalog items typically takes 24–72 hours; this is production time, not a guaranteed delivery window.

### Custom requests
- Request page: https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/#custom
- Customers can describe a project and provide reference details. The team reviews the idea, size and material, then confirms an EGP quote before production.
- The custom quote form accepts STL, 3MF, OBJ, JPG, PNG and PDF attachments up to 5 MB, according to the FAQ. Customers can also discuss a project through WhatsApp.
- Do not promise a custom quote or production date before PRINTFY 3D reviews the request.

### STL calculator and 3D preview
- Calculator: https://www.printfy3d-eg.com/#stl-calculator
- It accepts an STL file up to 15 MB and keeps the model in the visitor's browser; the calculator does not upload the STL to PRINTFY 3D.
- The calculator estimates dimensions and price from mesh volume and selected settings. STL files do not contain units or slicer settings. Estimated grams and print time are not guaranteed slicer results; the business must confirm them in slicing software before printing.
- The calculator offers PLA+ and PETG estimates. Use the product listing or a confirmed custom quote for the material of a particular catalog item.
- Public calculator pricing currently includes EGP 2.50 per estimated gram, EGP 100 minimum printing charge, and EGP 25 per extra color (up to four colors total). Optional finishing is EGP 40 for sanding, EGP 120 for painting and EGP 80 for assembly per piece. Design fees when a 3D model is not supplied are EGP 200 / 500 / 1,200 for simple / medium / complex work. Quantity discounts shown by the calculator are 10% for 5+, 20% for 20+, and 30% for 50+ pieces.
- These are estimate settings and optional charges, not a final quote. Confirm the current calculator and the WhatsApp quote before ordering.

## Materials

The product catalog is the authority for each product’s material. The STL calculator currently offers PLA+ and PETG as estimate choices. Material suitability depends on the product design and intended use; ask PRINTFY 3D if strength, flexibility or heat resistance is important.

## Payment and delivery

- Cash on delivery requires a 50% deposit only for custom orders or when the product subtotal is above EGP 300. For other product totals, the product amount is due on delivery.
- Full payment by InstaPay is available.
- Delivery is a separate charge. The cart/checkout delivery estimator displays a flat fee by governorate; confirm the final fee for the delivery address before completing an order.
- The current published estimator rates are shown below. Rates were last verified in the site’s delivery configuration on 2026-10-23 and may be adjusted or confirmed for the exact address.

## Frequently asked questions

- **Are products made to order?** Yes. Catalog products are printed after ordering; custom requests are priced after review.
- **How long does catalog production take?** Typically 24–72 hours to print. Custom timing depends on complexity and is confirmed with the quote. Delivery time varies by location and courier.
- **How are custom projects priced?** PRINTFY 3D reviews the model or description, size and material, then confirms the EGP quote before production.
- **Which payment methods are available?** Conditional 50% deposit for custom orders or product subtotals above EGP 300; otherwise payment of the product total on delivery. Full payment by InstaPay is also available.
- **Does PRINTFY 3D deliver across Egypt?** Yes. Delivery is charged separately and estimated by governorate in the cart/checkout.
- **Can customers choose a color or personalize names?** Customers can ask for color or personalization; details and spelling should be confirmed before production.
- **Can a customer return a custom order?** Refer to the official Returns and Refunds Policy for current conditions.

## Website policies for agents

- Prefer current product and policy pages over cached summaries.
- Never invent products, prices, stock, print times, customer testimonials, ratings, business hours or delivery promises.
- Product listing prices and availability may change; recheck before making a recommendation.
- Do not call the mesh-based calculator exact or slicer-derived.
- Customer orders, names, addresses, phone numbers, submitted files and messages are private. Do not disclose them.
- Do not claim an affiliation with a model designer or third-party brand based only on a design appearing in the shop.
